title: relationships-state/v1
description: state/relationships.json - the compiled edge set. Every edge is copied from a column another writer already filled (topology neighbors[], a bgp row's peer, a TE row's src_device/dst_device/hops[], a ticket's typed columns and rfc, a run's git.commit_sha + devices[]/interfaces[]), from an operator declaration (prod.json links[], TE tests[].path, tests[].service), or from an asserted relations[] row on state/health.json or state/network-ops.json. The compiler infers nothing.

status.description: ok: every source that exists was read and compiled. partial: a source that exists returned unusable content. unknown: no source returned content.

next_action.description: 'none', or 'Review drift[]: <n> rows' when drift is non-empty.

compiled_at.description: When this compile ran. Edge status values are as of this time.

read.description: Catalog paths that returned content this compile, in read order.

missing.description: Fixed-list sources that did not exist. A reader treats an edge kind whose source is here as 'no evidence', not 'no edge'.

watermarks.description: Catalog path -> the source's own time (board last_collected_at, topology mapped_at, state updated_at, snapshot collected_at, run updated_at). All equal to the prior file's -> no-op, no write.

drift.description: Mechanical intended-vs-observed differences for connected_to and traverses only, and only where an intended edge of that rel exists. Empty when prod.json links[] is empty and no TE test declares path.

keys.description: Deduplicated union of every edges[].from and edges[].to.

key.description: Entity key. An interface key is always interface:<device>/<interface>; a bare interface:<name> is rejected.

basis.description: Part of the identity: one row per (from, to, rel, basis). intended and observed rows for the same (from, to, rel) coexist; drift compares them.

sides.description: connected_to and peers_with (observed) only: 2 when both devices' own rows name each other, 1 when only one does. null on every other rel or basis.

first_seen.description: Source time when this row was first compiled. Never moves.

last_seen.description: Newest source time that produced this row: board last_collected_at, topology probed_at, state updated_at, run updated_at. Never the compile time.

seen_count.description: Number of compiles that produced this row.

sources.description: Catalog paths that produced this row, newest last. A changed edge lists the operational/runs/ path the Analyzer uses as treatment_ref.

status.description: As of compiled_at: observed stale after 7 days from last_seen, asserted after 30 days, intended never.

kind.description: intended_not_observed: declared, no current observed row. observed_not_intended: current observed row, not declared, and the source declares at least one edge of this rel (for traverses: for this test).

evidence_ref.description: The source of the edge that does exist: prod.json / TE board for intended, topology / TE board for observed.

since.description: compiled_at of the first compile that listed this row; carried forward while it persists.
